purpose: Lock the current shallow v0 knight Blueprint as an expected Gate A-E failure before Blueprint v2, canonical RenderSet, and metric schemas are implemented.

captureHarnessEvidence.usage: RND-101 proves deterministic browser beauty/alpha capture is available. These readback pixels are not used as proof for the v0-shallow Blueprint Gate A-E failures.

determinism.method: two captures of the same profile in one Playwright Chromium session must have identical readback hash, dimensions, and stats
determinism.freshnessPolicy: Run the command for fresh readback hashes; this static M0 report intentionally does not store pixel hashes.

metricReport.evidenceBasis: static v0-shallow Blueprint and tracked fixture manifest; no rendered v0-shallow Blueprint pixels exist yet

gates.label: Gate A
gates.evidence: The manifest has source and turnaround references, but v0-shallow.json only points at the hero 3/4 source image and has no source-aligned camera/pose or equipment-side contract.

gates.label: Gate B
gates.evidence: The baseline blueprint is a single root body with one accent child and lacks head/torso/arm/leg role separation, proportion measurements, landmarks, and pose measurements.

gates.label: Gate C
gates.evidence: Helmet slit, plume, shield rim, and sword guard are ledger feature cues on a shallow body/accent structure instead of separately addressable identity geometry with part-ID evidence.

gates.label: Gate D
gates.evidence: The v0 fixture has no hand, shield handle, plume root, cape anchor, or socket/contact distances; only accent_trim records a parent attachment.

gates.label: Gate E
gates.evidence: The blueprint defines steel, blue paint, and brass, but lacks cloth/leather role separation, albedo/material debug pass evidence, and black-crush/highlight-clipping metrics.

reviewPolicy.reason: Every Gate A-E entry is an expected initial failure; later work must replace this baseline with measured pass/fail evidence before approval.
